SPECTATEMOD-SPECTATING.title: Spectating
SPECTATEMOD-WHAT_GETS_REPLACED.title: What gets replaced
SPECTATEMOD-INDICATORS.title: Indicators
SPECTATEMOD-HOTKEYS.title: Hotkeys
SPECTATEMOD-TROUBLESHOOTING.title: Troubleshooting
SPECTATEMOD-COPY_ERROR_REPORT.title: Report a bug
SPECTATEMOD-COPY_ERROR_REPORT.descriptio: Copies a short report to your clipboard: the game and mod versions, your other mods, and the errors from this session and the last one. Paste it wherever you report the bug. Steam ids and your Windows user name are left out.
SPECTATEMOD-ENABLE_HOTKEYS.title: Enable hotkeys
SPECTATEMOD-ENABLE_HOTKEYS.description: Spectate a player or stop spectating with the keys below.
SPECTATEMOD-HOTKEY_MODIFIER.title: Hold with every hotkey
SPECTATEMOD-HOTKEY_MODIFIER.description: Key to hold together with each hotkey. The number keys on their own already pick cards in hand; with None the hotkey takes the key over.
SPECTATEMOD-SPECTATE_PLAYER1_KEY.title: Spectate player 1
SPECTATEMOD-SPECTATE_PLAYER1_KEY.descrip: Watch the player in the first box on the right. If that is you, stop spectating.
SPECTATEMOD-SPECTATE_PLAYER2_KEY.title: Spectate player 2
SPECTATEMOD-SPECTATE_PLAYER2_KEY.descrip: Watch the player in the second box on the right. If that is you, stop spectating.
SPECTATEMOD-SPECTATE_PLAYER3_KEY.title: Spectate player 3
SPECTATEMOD-SPECTATE_PLAYER3_KEY.descrip: Watch the player in the third box on the right. If that is you, stop spectating.
SPECTATEMOD-SPECTATE_PLAYER4_KEY.title: Spectate player 4
SPECTATEMOD-SPECTATE_PLAYER4_KEY.descrip: Watch the player in the fourth box on the right. If that is you, stop spectating.
SPECTATEMOD-STOP_SPECTATING_KEY.title: Stop spectating
SPECTATEMOD-STOP_SPECTATING_KEY.descript: Go back to your own screen.
SPECTATEMOD-AUTO_SPECTATE_AFTER_END_TURN: Auto spectate after ending your turn
Automatically switch to a teammate who is still alive and has not ended their turn.
SPECTATEMOD-MANUAL_SPECTATE_ON_CLICK.des: Click a teammate to start or stop spectating them. Click your own character to stop spectating.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATE_BUTTONS.title: Spectate button in the party list
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATE_BUTTONS.descri: Show an eye next to each player's icon in the top-left party list to start or stop watching them.
SPECTATEMOD-AUTO_SPECTATE_ON_DEATH.title: Auto spectate when you die
SPECTATEMOD-AUTO_SPECTATE_ON_DEATH.descr: Start watching a teammate as soon as you die. Prefers someone still taking their turn, but will settle for any teammate who is alive.
SPECTATEMOD-PREFERRED_TEAMMATE_SLOT.desc: Teammate to prefer for auto spectate. 0 picks the first eligible teammate. If the preferred teammate is dead or has ended their turn, another eligible teammate is used.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_HAND_PEEK_BAR.title: Player boxes on the right edge
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_HAND_PEEK_BAR.descripti: Show a small box per player down the right edge of the screen, for the whole run. Click one to spectate that player until you click again, or click your own to come back.
SPECTATEMOD-DRAW_ON_CLICK.title: Draw on their screen
SPECTATEMOD-DRAW_ON_CLICK.description: While spectating, hold the right mouse button and drag to draw on the teammate's screen. Anyone else watching them sees it too, and the line wipes itself away a moment later. Both of you need this mod.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_HAND.title: Replace your hand
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_HAND.description: Show the spectated teammate's hand in place of your own.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_COMBAT_UI.title: Replace combat UI
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_COMBAT_UI.descriptio: Point the draw, discard and exhaust piles, the energy orb and the star counter at the teammate you are watching.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_RELICS.title: Replace relics
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_RELICS.description: Show the spectated teammate's relics in the top bar instead of your own.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_POTIONS.title: Replace potions
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_POTIONS.description: Show the spectated teammate's potions in the top bar instead of your own. You can read them, but not use them.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_GOLD_AND_HP.title: Replace gold, HP and portrait
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_GOLD_AND_HP.descript: Show the spectated teammate's gold, hit points and character portrait in the top bar instead of your own.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_DECK.title: Replace deck
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_DECK.description: Show the spectated teammate's deck in the top bar instead of your own: its card count, and their cards when you open it.
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_HEALTH_BARS.title: Show their health bars as yours
SPECTATEMOD-REPLACE_HEALTH_BARS.descript: Keep the watched teammate's health bar, and their pets' like Osty, up all the time the way yours normally is. Yours only shows when you point at your character.
SPECTATEMOD-SWAP_COMBAT_POSITIONS.title: Move them to your spot
SPECTATEMOD-SWAP_COMBAT_POSITIONS.descri: Slide the watched teammate to your place at the front of the board, and you back among the others.
SPECTATEMOD-INTENTS_FOR_WATCHED.title: Enemy intents against them
SPECTATEMOD-INTENTS_FOR_WATCHED.descript: Show enemy attacks with the damage the watched teammate would take, counting their own powers like Vulnerable, instead of yours.
SPECTATEMOD-ENEMY_POWERS_FOR_WATCHED.des: Show what enemies hold against the watched teammate instead of you, like The Insatiable's countdown or the card a Thieving Hopper stole from them.
SPECTATEMOD-MIRROR_HOVER.title: Mirror card hover
SPECTATEMOD-MIRROR_HOVER.description: Raise the card the teammate is inspecting.
SPECTATEMOD-INSPECT_TEAMMATE_CARDS.title: Inspect their cards with your mouse
SPECTATEMOD-INSPECT_TEAMMATE_CARDS.descr: Point at a card in the spectated hand to lift it and read it, whatever the teammate is doing.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_CARD_PLAY_VISUALS.title: Show card play and targeting
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_CARD_PLAY_VISUALS.descr: Draw the teammate's targeting arrow and selection reticle in your own view.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_LABEL.title: Show "Spectating" label
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_LABEL.descri: Show the name of the player you are watching at the top of the screen.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_BORDER.title: Show red screen border
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_SPECTATING_BORDER.descr: Outline the screen in red while spectating.
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_OWN_ENERGY.title: Show your own energy
SPECTATEMOD-SHOW_OWN_ENERGY.description: While the combat UI shows a teammate's energy, keep a smaller orb with yours beside it.
